summary: Mission 2 Day Care Customer Booking UI — backend + frontend acceptance testing. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases PASS covering /api/payments/hourly-pricing (legacy afternoon, morning Happy-Hour, daycare 4-entry shape), end-to-end PK-D-* daycare cash booking, PK-H-* main_area cash booking, capacity overbook rejection, subscription/birthday regression. Frontend: service selector card, daycare/main-area buttons, default main_area state, daycare flow (stepper pill for period is dropped, 'اختر مدة الحضانة' title, daycare pricing chips 11/19/26/33, 'حضانة 8 ص - 5 م' slot description) all visually verified via Playwright + screenshots.

minor.issue: Main_area cash bookings via offline endpoint are priced at morning rate (3.5/hr) regardless of the slot's start_time or a payload time_mode='afternoon' hint (offline endpoint appears to default time_mode=morning). This is pre-existing Mission-1 behaviour, NOT introduced by Mission 2. PK-H-* prefix and service_type='main_area' stamping are correct. Flag for product decision — do you want offline main_area to respect afternoon pricing?

issues: Slot pill buttons lack a data-testid (only className='slot-btn slot-pill'). Low priority but would make future automation more robust — add e.g. data-testid={`slot-pill-${slot.id}`} at line 1086 of TicketsPage.js.

action_items: (Optional, minor) Add data-testid to slot pill buttons in TicketsPage.js line ~1086 so downstream UI tests can stably select a time slot.
(Optional, pre-existing) Decide whether offline main_area hourly bookings should honour afternoon pricing when slot.start_time >= 13:00 — currently always prices at morning rate.
critical_code_review_comments: payments.js /hourly-pricing daycare branch (lines 683-705) is correctly shaped: 4-entry array, service_type='daycare', extra_hour_* cleared, reads from Settings with DAYCARE_PRICING_DEFAULTS fallback — exactly per spec.

TicketsPage.js correctly gates the period card on !isDaycare, resets downstream selections on service switch, relabels duration title, switches to amber palette, and stamps summary-service-badge text 'حضانة Day Care' vs 'اللعب بالساعة'. confirmationData passed to /booking-confirmation includes serviceType.

BookingConfirmationPage.js inferServiceType() correctly falls back to booking_code prefix (PK-D- → daycare) so even legacy/Capital-Bank-redirect flows surface the right label. PaymentSuccessPage.js buildConfirmationData persists serviceType into localStorage handoff.
Mission 1 regression intact: birthday, subscription plans, main_area PK-H-* classification, and capacity enforcement all green.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of visible-state + code-review checks (slot-pill click blocked by missing data-testid; bypassed via code review)
